pitLanes.modeReason: closed for now, though it could be drivable (a straight, parallel lane beside the Wheatcroft Straight, 4 m longer than the track): a car in the lane would miss the finish checkpoint (it spans the track only) and the track's barrier plan has no gaps for the merges yet
pitLanes.widthSource: estimated from the gap between the track's edge and the pit garages (OSM 'Pit Garages 1-38' 410366924, LIDAR)

paddocks.name: Paddock (behind the pit garages)
paddocks.source: hand-drawn over the LIDAR relief and the OSM service roads: the ground behind the pit garages (OSM 410366924), the scrutineering bay (410366927) and the Redgate Suites, inside the Melbourne loop; OSM has no paddock polygon

gantries.name: start/finish line
gantries.source: the recipe's line (driver61.com coordinates; MSV maps), beside the middle of the pit lane

gantries.name: footbridge before the line
gantries.source: LIDAR (EA NLP 2022, SK4025): a span across the road at s 3912-3916 m, top 8.0-8.8 m, between Goddards and the line

sources.osm: OpenStreetMap (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0: Overpass over the recipe bbox, 2026-10-24 (tools/real_tracks_data/fetch_pits_osm.py)
sources.lidar: Environment Agency National LIDAR Programme point cloud 2022 (SK4025) minus the LIDAR Composite DTM 1 m, OGL v3
sources.maps: MSV GP map (.local/realtracks/doningtonpark/maps/gp.jpg): pit lane on the inside of the Wheatcroft Straight from Goddards
